name: Wide Arcade 16:9
description: Keeps the complete KI1 4:3 game frame centered and fills the side gutters with a dark, blurred scene extension.
notes: The original gameplay frame is never stretched, cropped or zoomed.
For a 1920x1080 output, the centered gameplay viewport is 1440x1080 and the remaining 240 pixels on each side are backdrop gutters.
The gutters use a blurred, darker copy of the scene; this is a presentation hack, not additional game camera visibility.
Keep the game HUD and OSD inside the same centered 4:3 viewport.
On 4:3 output the game fills the output and no gutters are generated.
